facts.text: Code data type fields with lowercase characters and whitespace must be cleaned before cloud migration to prevent failures in the cloud.
Run Invoke-NAVSanitizeField PowerShell cmdlet from Business Central Administration Shell against the on-premises database to delete invalid characters.
Cmdlet returns object containing number of rows modified, tables impacted, and potentially ignored records list.
Company names with trailing spaces, leading spaces, or carriage return characters prevent those companies from being picked up for migration.
Use SQL query to identify corrupted company names instead of the sanitize field cmdlet, then manually correct them.
Compress and archive out-of-date data using Data Archive extension page 9035 to improve migration performance.
